entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Python libraries such as Flask, SciPy, scikit-learn, Keras, and PyTorch
reading.format: It is a 16-course series delivered online with hands-on labs, projects, and practical evaluations, including a guided project to create a real-world generative AI application. The content is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: This is a 16-course professional certificate from IBM on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, including large language models, natural language processing, machine learning, and deep learning with Python. Learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents, and chatbots using frameworks such as PyTorch, LangChain, and Hugging Face Transformers. Completing it demonstrates practical, job-ready skills for roles like gen AI engineer or AI developer.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring generative AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers. No prior experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: No prior experience is required; the page lists it as beginner level.
